trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Cooltrainer (Male, Elite Variant)
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T071 must not be allowed near high-threat SCPs without Level-3 supervision.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T071 displays elite-level combat adaptability and can coordinate multiple SCP entities simultaneously. Frequently used in advanced containment simulations.
addendum_logs: Addendum T071-A: SCP-T071 neutralized SCP-0054 (Psyduck)’s psychic burst using improvised countermeasures.
Addendum T071-B: SCP-T071 resisted SCP-0077 (Ponyta)’s flame output with minimal injury.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Cooltrainer (Female, Elite Variant)

trainer_scp.description: SCP-T072 displays exceptional tactical reasoning and multi-type coordination. Frequently participates in high-risk containment drills.

Addendum T072-B: SCP-T072 resisted SCP-0087 (Dewgong)’s freezing mist with minimal impairment.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Tamer (Elite Variant)

trainer_scp.description: SCP-T073 displays anomalous dominance over aggressive SCP entities, capable of suppressing rage states through vocal command and physical presence.

Addendum T073-B: SCP-T073 resisted SCP-0077 (Ponyta)’s flame surge with minor injuries.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Scientist (High-Level)
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T074 must not be allowed to test prototypes on live SCPs without Level-4 approval.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T074 displays advanced anomalous research capability, frequently producing containment devices that exceed expected performance.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Obsessive, brilliant, and prone to overwork.
addendum_logs: Addendum T074-A: SCP-T074’s prototype stabilized SCP-0101 (Electrode) for 72 hours.
Addendum T074-B: SCP-T074 predicted SCP-0095 (Onix)’s tunnel collapse 8 minutes before sensors.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Psychic (Elite Variant)
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must maintain cognitive shielding. SCP-T075 must not be exposed to SCP-T009 (Sabrina).
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T075 displays mid-level psychic abilities capable of suppressing low-threat psychic SCP entities and predicting short-term events.
addendum_logs: Addendum T075-A: SCP-T075 suppressed SCP-0064 (Kadabra)’s psychic pulse.
Addendum T075-B: SCP-T075 predicted a containment breach 5 minutes before occurrence.

Addendum T076-B: SCP-T076’s spectral projection disrupted containment sensors.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Dragon Tamer (Elite Variant)

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Gambler (Elite Variant)
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid allowing SCP-T078 near volatile SCPs. Probability dampeners required during interaction.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T078 displays extreme probability distortion, causing unpredictable outcomes in nearby systems. Effects intensify during emotional stress.
addendum_logs: Addendum T078-A: SCP-T078 caused five simultaneous low-probability events during testing.
Addendum T078-B: SCP-0100 (Voltorb) detonated prematurely during SCP-T078’s presence.

addendum_logs: Addendum T079-A: SCP-T079 bypassed four biometric locks in under 60 seconds.
Addendum T079-B: SCP-T079 escaped containment using improvised tools.
